tool_args.rationale: The new low-gradient point helps constrain the base response, but the higher-gradient points still vary in input as well as gradient. The batch is the remaining relevant probe for distinguishing a smooth sink from a jointly activated one before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It already added a low-gradient observation. Repeating that measurement would not separate an input–gradient interaction from gradient-only suppression.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth baseline with a gradient-only avalanche threshold
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All six observations are below the recalled threshold range, and the fitted baseline has a training RMSE of about 0.072, above the 0.045 confirmation tolerance.

Haldane omits the observed gradient effect, while Cobb–Douglas forces the gradient elasticity to stay constant across input levels. Neither can represent a sink that activates only when both conditions hold.
